title: TCP Flow Control Mechanism #1
statement: How does TCP implement flow control to prevent sender from overwhelming receiver buffer?

options.text: Sliding Window Protocol with advertised receiver window (rwnd)

explanation: Receiver includes `rwnd` in TCP header acknowledging remaining free buffer space.
